title: Algebraic degree of a product
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$ and all functions $f,g:(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n\to\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$, the algebraic degree of their pointwise product is at most the sum of their algebraic degrees. Here the algebraic degree is the largest cardinality of a set $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ whose coefficient in the algebraic normal form is nonzero.
